stations.body: Every system begins at the waterline. This is the edge of the island — sand, shallow turquoise, and a track that climbs inland.

stations.label: The Plains
stations.title: Foundations
stations.subtitle: Open ground, deep roots
stations.body: Four years of fundamentals — data structures, systems, statistics — laid out flat and wide before anything got built on top.

items.title: B.Tech, Computer Science & Engineering (Data Science)
items.org: D. J. Sanghvi College of Engineering
points: Core: Data Structures & Algorithms, OOP, DBMS, Operating Systems.
Specialisation in Data Science — statistics, machine learning, applied NLP.
Consistently top-decile across six semesters.

stations.label: The Canopy
stations.title: Things I have built
stations.subtitle: Dense, layered, alive
stations.body: Full-stack platforms with agentic AI underneath. Every one of these shipped end to end — schema, model, pipeline, deploy.

items.title: StudyStack
items.subtitle: AI-powered student financing & engagement platform
points: Full-stack platform streamlining student counselling, university discovery and education-loan workflows.
AI loan-intelligence module: eligibility estimation, personalised recommendations, ROI/EMI analysis.
Voice-based AI counselling with persistent conversation memory for automated profile extraction.
Agentic workflow engine for campaign generation and multi-channel outreach across email, WhatsApp and social.
Dual-pass RAG policy engine ingesting bank loan PDFs, extracting eligibility rules and validating LLM output through an independent faithfulness verifier.

items.title: OneFlow
items.subtitle: Enterprise project-management ERP
points: ERP platform managing projects, tasks, timesheets and financial workflows — sales orders, invoices, purchase orders.
Relational schema of 20+ models with NextAuth, JWT sessions and role-based access control.
CI/CD via GitHub Actions with optimised multi-stage Docker builds.
Deployed on Google Cloud Run — serverless auto-scaling, zero-downtime releases.

items.title: ChainForecast CRM
items.subtitle: Agentic sales forecasting with blockchain auditability
points: Gemini-powered agents convert natural-language campaign briefs into executable multi-agent workflows for strategy, research, copy, creative and distribution.
Dependency-aware execution engine with persistent workflow state in MongoDB.
Random-Forest forecasting (200 trees) producing 28-day demand forecasts at <5% MAE on large retail time-series.
Customer intelligence via RFM analysis and K-Means clustering — VIP, Regular and At-Risk segments.
Ethereum + Merkle trees for tamper-proof audit trails over AI predictions.

stations.label: The City
stations.title: Where I work
stations.subtitle: Production, not prototypes
stations.body: Real users, real load, real consequences. The skyline is everything that has to stay up.

items.title: Software Engineer Apprentice
points: Hands-on training in the Frappe Framework and ERPNext — full-stack development, framework architecture and enterprise ERP workflows.
Building with Python, JavaScript, Redis and Docker across scalable backend services.
Enterprise practice: debugging, testing and deployment in a production-grade environment.

items.title: AI & Software Development Intern
points: Built AI-powered products on MongoDB, Firebase, Gemini and OpenAI APIs; deployed to AWS EC2 with S3 image storage and Secrets Manager.
End-to-end Meta Ads optimisation pipeline — Shopify/e-commerce scraping, LLM ad-copy generation and performance analytics.
AI-driven targeting and creative optimisation, lifting conversion rates ~20–35% and campaign revenue.

stations.body: Wide, arid, and covered end to end. Nothing here is decoration — each one has shipped something.
